cd <workspace>; cat > tests/test_spec.py <<'EOF'
import os
import tempfile
import unittest

from confkit import ParseError, load, loads


def err(text, **kw):
    with unittest.TestCase().assertRaises(ParseError) as ctx:
        loads(text, **kw)
    return ctx.exception.message.split(":")[0], ctx.exception.lineno


class SpecTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scalars(self):
        t = "a=True\nb=-0\nc=1_000\nd=-0b101\ne=0o17\nf=.5\ng=5.\nh=1e3\ni=-2.5E-3\nj=1_0.2\nk=00.5\nl=007e1\n"
        self.assertEqual(loads(t), dict(a=True, b=0, c=1000, d=-5, e=15, f=.5, g=5., h=1000., i=-.0025, j=10.2, k=.5, l=70.))
        for s in ["007", "1__0", "_1", "inf", "nan", "yes", "1.2.3", "0x", "1e", "+", ".", "0x_1", "1._5"]:
            self.assertEqual(loads("x = " + s), {"x": s}, s)

    def test_multiline_and_comments(self):
        self.assertEqual(loads("h =\n  a\n# c\n\n  b  # p\nz = x;y\n"), {"h": "a\nb", "z": "x;y"})
        self.assertEqual(loads("h =\n"), {"h": ""})
        self.assertEqual(loads("h = 1\n  2\n"), {"h": "1\n2"})
        self.assertEqual(loads("a = 'x' # c\nb = \"a#b\" ; c\r\nc = 1\rd = 2"), {"a": "x", "b": "a#b", "c": 1, "d": 2})

    def test_lists(self):
        self.assertEqual(loads("a = [it's, [1, [2]], 'x',]"), {"a": ["it's", [1, [2]], "x"]})
        self.assertEqual(loads("a = [1, # c\n 2 ; d\n]"), {"a": [1, 2]})
        self.assertEqual(loads("a = [a#b, c ;d\n]"), {"a": ["a#b", "c"]})
        for bad in ["[1,,2]", "[,]", "[1 2]", "[1] x", "[1]#c", "[a[b]]", "[\"a\" \"b\"]"]:
            self.assertEqual(err("a = " + bad), ("invalid list", 1), bad)
        self.assertEqual(err("a = [1,\n 2"), ("unterminated list", 1))

    def test_string_errors(self):
        self.assertEqual(err('a = "\\q"'), ("invalid escape", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err('a = "\\u12"'), ("invalid escape", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err('a = "x" y'), ("unexpected text after string", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err('a = "x"#y'), ("unexpected text after string", 1))
        self.assertEqual(loads('a = "\\u0041\\0\\\\"'), {"a": "A\0\\"})

    def test_structure_errors(self):
        self.assertEqual(err("  x"), ("continuation without a value", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err("[a]\n  x"), ("continuation without a value", 2))
        self.assertEqual(err("[a"), ("invalid section header", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err("[a]x"), ("invalid section header", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err("a b"), ("invalid line", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err("@includes x"), ("invalid line", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err("a = 1\na.b = 2"), ("key conflict", 2))
        self.assertEqual(err("a.b = 1\na = 2"), ("key conflict", 2))
        self.assertEqual(err("a = 1\n[a]"), ("key conflict", 2))
        self.assertEqual(err("a = 1\n[a.b]"), ("key conflict", 2))
        self.assertEqual(err("a = 1\na = \"\\q\""), ("invalid escape", 2))
        self.assertEqual(err("x = [\n\"\\q\"\n]\n"), ("invalid escape", 1))
        self.assertEqual(loads("[a.b]\n[a]\n[ c ] # x\n"), {"a": {"b": {}}, "c": {}})
        self.assertEqual(err("[a]\n[a]"), ("duplicate section", 2))
        self.assertEqual(loads("\ufeffa = 1"), {"a": 1})

    def test_includes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            def w(n, t):
                os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.join(d, n)), exist_ok=True)
                open(os.path.join(d, n), "w").write(t)
            w("m.ini", "[s]\n@include 'sub/o.ini' # c\nk = 1\n")
            w("sub/o.ini", "x = 2\n[t]\ny = 3\n")
            self.assertEqual(load(os.path.join(d, "m.ini")), {"s": {"k": 1}, "x": 2, "t": {"y": 3}})
            w("dup.ini", '@include "sub/o.ini"\n@include "sub/o.ini"\n')
            with self.assertRaises(ParseError) as c:
                load(os.path.join(d, "dup.ini"))
            self.assertEqual((c.exception.lineno, c.exception.source, c.exception.message.split(":")[0]),
                             (1, os.path.join(d, "sub/o.ini"), "duplicate key"))
            w("c.ini", '@include "c.ini"\n')
            with self.assertRaises(ParseError) as c:
                load(os.path.join(d, "c.ini"))
            self.assertEqual(c.exception.message.split(":")[0], "include cycle")
            w("cont.ini", '@include "sub/o.ini"\n  x\n')
            with self.assertRaises(ParseError) as c:
                load(os.path.join(d, "cont.ini"))
            self.assertEqual(c.exception.lineno, 2)
            w("miss.ini", '@include "nope.ini"\n')
            with self.assertRaises(ParseError) as c:
                load(os.path.join(d, "miss.ini"))
            self.assertEqual(c.exception.message.split(":")[0], "cannot read include")
            with self.assertRaises(OSError):
                load(os.path.join(d, "none"))
        self.assertEqual(err('@include "x"'), ("include needs a base directory", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err('@include x', base_dir="."), ("invalid include", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err('@include', base_dir="."), ("invalid include", 1))
EOF
